event_data.context: Filesystem PRs #4 and #5 merged. SQLite revision f1aaf0f passed 37 local tests in each backend mode. Review confirmed the four earlier fixes and found that a supplied trigger can silently ignore a write. PR #6 is back in draft while event inserts are required to affect exactly one row and rollback is tested with count_changes both enabled and disabled. PostgreSQL and snapshots remain in progress.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the durable storage and command state capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Durable storage and command state
